To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of Bode diagrams can help to identify the frequency and voltage sensitivity of the system to load variations, and that the use of the Bode plots can help to identify which frequency control strategies can improve system operation and reliability.
the use of Bode Plots as an analysis tool is a good method to determine the frequency sensitivity of a power system.

1) the use of the Bode diagram is a good tool for the analysis of system sensitivity; 2) the system frequency sensitivity to disturbances in active and reactive loads depends on the topology of the system; 3) a frequency and voltage controller can be designed to improve the system performance in the presence of disturbances; 4) the system frequency can be controlled to improve the voltage stability; 5) the system voltage can be controlled to reduce the frequency deviation.

the development of a frequency control strategy for the IEEE 9-bus system.
developing a methodology that can be applied in the design of frequency control systems for power systems.
the development of a frequency and voltage control scheme for a power system with the aim of improving system stability and reliability.

the study of the system sensitivities could be an important tool to develop disturbance rejection strategies to improve the system operation.
the use of Bode diagrams is an efficient tool for system analysis and for disturbance rejection design.
the use of Bode plot analysis for system frequency and voltage control design is an efficient and useful tool.

we can control the frequency of a system using the topology information of a power system.
